arxiv-2010-06274.title: Swarming of Aerial Robots with Markov Random Field Optimization
arxiv-2010-06274.creator: Paper ID, Malintha Fernando, Lantao Liu
arxiv-2010-06274.description: Abstract I Abstract Swarms are highly robust systems that offer unique benefits compared to their alternatives. In this work, we propose a bio-inspired and artificial potential field-driven robot swarm control method, where the swarm formation dynamics are modeled on the basis of Markov Random Field (MRF) optimization.

arxiv-2201-07013.creator: Anabik Pal, Zhiyun Xue, Sameer Antani
arxiv-2201-07013.description: Abstract Cervical cancer is the fourth most common cancer in women worldwide. The availability of a robust automated cervical image classification system can augment the clinical care provider’s limitation in traditional visual inspection with acetic acid (VIA). However, there are a wide variety of cervical inspection objectives which impact the labeling criteria for criteria-specific prediction model development.

arxiv-2304-05165.title: Exploring and Exploiting Uncertainty for Incomplete Multi-View Classification
arxiv-2304-05165.creator: Mengyao Xie, Zongbo Han, Changqing Zhang, Yichen Bai, Qinghua Hu
arxiv-2304-05165.description: Abstract Classifying incomplete multi-view data is inevitable since arbitrary view missing widely exists in real-world applications. Although great progress has been achieved, existing incomplete multi-view methods are still difficult to obtain a trustworthy prediction due to the relatively high uncertainty nature of missing views.

arxiv-2309-00783.title: Diffusion Modeling with Domain-conditioned Prior Guidance for Accelerated MRI and qMRI Reconstruction

arxiv-2309-00783.description: Abstract This study introduces a novel approach for image reconstruction based on a diffusion model conditioned on the native data domain. Our method is applied to multi-coil MRI and quantitative MRI reconstruction, leveraging the domain-conditioned diffusion model within the frequency and parameter domains.

arxiv-2402-06055.title: Gliding in extreme waters: Dynamic Modeling and Nonlinear Control of an Agile Underwater Glider
arxiv-2402-06055.creator: Hanzhi Yang, Nina Mahmoudian
arxiv-2402-06055.description: Abstract This paper describes the modeling of a custom-made underwater glider capable of flexible maneuvers in constrained areas and proposes a control system. Due to the lack of external actuators, underwater gliders can be greatly influenced by environmental disturbance. In addition, the nonlinearity of the system affects the motions during the transition between each flight segment.

arxiv-2412-07572.title: Three-dimensional integral Faddeev equations without a certain symmetry
arxiv-2412-07572.creator: Egorov Mikhail
arxiv-2412-07572.description: Abstract A method for the direct integration of the three-dimensional Faddeev equations with respect to the breakup T-matrix in momentum space for three-body systems with differing masses is presented. The Faddeev equations are explicitly formulated without imposing symmetry or antisymmetry requirements on the two-body t-matrices, thus accounting for mass differences between the three interacting particles.

arxiv-2502-11256.title: Unveiling Environmental Impacts of Large Language Model Serving: A Functional Unit View
arxiv-2502-11256.creator: Yanran Wu, Inez Hua, Yi Ding
arxiv-2502-11256.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yanran Wu, Inez Hua, Yi Ding. Large language models (LLMs) offer powerful capabilities but come with significant environmental impact, particularly in carbon emissions. Existing studies benchmark carbon emissions but lack a standardized basis for comparison across different model configurations. To address this, we introduce the concept of functional unit (FU) as a standardized basis and develop FUEL, the first FU-based framework for evaluating LLM serving’s environmental impact.

pmc-13589773.title: 内质网应激抑制剂4-苯基丁酸对脓毒症小鼠心肌损伤的保护作用
pmc-13589773.creator: 洧 熊, 金伟 戴, 文晔 许, 锐 金, 嫕婷 陈, 丽娜 张, 招昕 钱
pmc-13589773.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). 目的内质网应激(endoplasmic reticulum stress，ERS)是脓毒症相关心肌损伤(sepsis-related myocardial injury，SRMI)发生和发展的重要病理生理机制之一。本研究旨在探讨ERS抑制剂4-苯基丁酸(4-phenylbutyric acid，4PBA)对脂多糖(lipopolysaccharides，LPS)诱导的SRMI的保护作用。方法给予C57BL/6J雄性小鼠腹腔注射LPS构建小鼠SRMI模型。在第1组实验中，将小鼠随机分为5组(n=6)：对照(control)组、LPS 6 h组、LPS 12 h组、LPS 24 h组和LPS 48 h组。在第2组实验中，将小鼠随机分为4组(n=6)：control组、LPS组、衣霉素(tunicamycin，TM)组、TM+LPS组。在第3组实验中，将小鼠随机分为4组(n=6)：control组、LPS组、4PBA组、4PBA+LPS组。在第4组实验中，将小鼠随机分为4组(n=8)：LPS组、TM组、TM+LPS组、4PBA+LPS组。在注射LPS前6 h，腹腔注射TM(0.5 mg/kg)，注射LPS前6 h及注射后6 h给予4PBA(10 mg/kg)。采用心脏超声检测评价小鼠心功能，酶联免疫吸附测定(enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay，ELISA)检测小鼠血浆中心肌肌钙蛋白I(cardiac troponin I，cTnI)和肌酸激酶同工酶(creatine kinase-MB，CK-MB)的水平及心脏组织中白细胞介素-1β(interleukin-1β，IL-1β)的含量，苏木精-伊红(hematoxylin-eosin，HE)染色观察心肌组织形态学变化，蛋白质印迹法检测心脏组织中ERS相关蛋白质肌醇需求酶1α(inositol-requiring enzyme 1α，IRE1α)、磷酸化蛋白激酶R样内质网激酶(phospho-protein kinase R-like endoplasmic reticulum kinase，p-PERK)、激活转录因子6的剪切形式(cleaved-activating transcription factor 6，cleaved-ATF6)、剪接型X盒结合蛋白1(spliced X-box binding protein 1，XBP1s)、CCAAT/增强子结合蛋白同源蛋白(CCAAT enhancer binding protein-homologous protein，CHOP)、葡萄糖调节蛋白78(glucose regulated protein 78，GRP78)，以及炎症因子肿瘤坏死因子α(tumor necrosis factor-α，TNF-α)的表达情况。采用LPS处理HL-1小鼠心肌细胞系构建脓毒症细胞模型。分别采用原位末端转移酶标记法(terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase-mediated dUTP-biotin nick end labeling，TUNEL)、线粒体膜电位染色评估心肌细胞凋亡及线粒体膜电位的变化。结果与control组比较，LPS 6 h组、LPS 12 h组、LPS 24 h组和LPS 48 h组小鼠左室射血分数(ejection fraction，EF)、短轴缩短率(fractional shortening，FS)随时间推移先降低后恢复，血浆cTnI、CK-MB水平和心肌组织IL-1β水平先升高后下降，心脏组织ERS相关蛋白质IRE1α、XBP1s、p-PERK、CHOP、cleaved-ATF6、GRP78均显著升高(均P<0.05)，心肌组织出现明显水肿、肌纤维断裂及血管间隙消失。与LPS组相比，4PBA+LPS组小鼠EF、短轴FS均显著回升，血浆cTnI、CK-MB水平及心肌组织IL-1β水平均显著下降，心肌组织中ERS相关蛋白质及炎症因子TNF-α表达水平均显著下调(均P<0.05)；心肌组织病理损伤明显改善，小鼠的5 d生存率有升高趋势。TM+LPS组则呈现与4PBA+LPS组相反的变化。在LPS处理HL-1小鼠心肌细胞系构建的脓毒症细胞模型中，线粒体膜电位检测结果显示，与LPS组比较，4PBA+LPS组线粒体膜电位改善(均P<0.05)；TUNEL凋亡检测结果显示，与LPS组比较，4PBA+LPS组TUNEL阳性细胞比率显著降低(均P<0.05)。结论激活ERS可加重LPS诱导的SRMI，4PBA通过抑制ERS的过度激活，减轻炎症反应，减少心肌细胞凋亡，改善心功能并降低病死率。靶向ERS可能成为脓毒症心肌损伤的潜在治疗策略。 脓毒症相关心肌损伤(sepsis-related myocardial injury，SRMI)是脓毒症患者常见的并发症之一，在全球范围内，脓毒症患者的SRMI发生率为10%~70%，且合并心肌损伤的脓毒症患者通常预后不良[1]。内质网应激(endoplasmic reticulum stress，ERS)是未折叠蛋白、错误蛋白过度累积所导致的内质网功能紊乱。持续的ERS将导致细胞内钙离子代谢障碍、氧化应激损伤、线粒体功能失衡，最终诱发各种类型的细胞死亡。ERS是SRMI发生和发展的重要病理生理机制之一[2]。 ERS由3种内质网跨膜传感器介导，即肌醇需求酶1(inositol-requiring enzyme 1，IRE1)、磷酸化蛋白激酶R样内质网激酶(phospho-protein kinase R-like endoplasmic reticulum kinase，p-PERK)、激活转录因子6(activating transcription factor 6，ATF6)[3]。这3种信号蛋白质识别氧化应激损伤、细胞内未折叠蛋白质及错误蛋白质持续累积、钙离子失衡等刺激信号后，相继被激活，进而启动下游的未折叠蛋白质应答(unfolded protein response，UPR)[4]。在适应性阶段，UPR通过抑制蛋白质翻译和减少蛋白质进入内质网以减轻负荷；但若ERS持续存在，UPR则转而加速内质网功能崩溃，最终诱导凋亡等多种细胞死亡途径[5]。

pmc-13644515.title: Urinary Proteomics Enables Noninvasive and Longitudinal Monitoring of Tumor Burden Dynamics and Early Recurrence in Hepatocellular Carcinoma
pmc-13644515.creator: Xiaohua Xing, En Hu, Lei Song, Zhao Zheng, Linsheng Cai, Jiahe Ouyang, Jie Li, Xinting Pan, Mingxin Liu, Yingchao Wang, Xiaolong Liu
pmc-13644515.description: To develop a noninvasive, urine-based approach for dynamic monitoring of tumor burden and early detection of recurrence in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), addressing the limited sensitivity of conventional serum biomarkers such as AFP and DCP, particularly for minimal residual disease (MRD) assessment. We established a prospective, multi-cohort urinary proteomics framework encompassing four longitudinal clinical cohorts (378 patients, 972 urine samples).

pmc-13653573.title: Flavin Catalysts in Organic Synthesis
pmc-13653573.creator: Jan Freudenberg, Golo Storch
pmc-13653573.description: Flavin cofactors are nature's all‐rounders with several essential roles in the active site of flavin‐dependent enzymes. These flavoenzymes display an astonishingly broad activity spectrum, which also translates to the organic laboratory. In synthetic chemistry, flavin catalysis is now an integral part of several organocatalytic and photochemical methods with applications ranging from total synthesis to biocompatible photoproximity labeling.

pmc-13688807.title: Menaquinone synthesis genes are critical for the decolorization of acid yellow 36 in Shewanella putrefaciens CN32
pmc-13688807.creator: Jiawen Liu, Jing Yang, Aofei Sun, Hao Guan, Weibing Chen, Heng Geng, Xiaoxuan Zhang, Zhaolan Li, Di Sun, Jingrong Zhu, Zhen Dong, Cong Liu, Weijie Liu
pmc-13688807.description: The anaerobic decolorization of azo dyes by Shewanella species relies on an intricate electron transfer network, yet the full complement of genes involved remains incompletely defined. In this study, we used mini-Tn5 transposon mutagenesis to identify genes required for the decolorization of the azo dye acid yellow 36 in Shewanella putrefaciens CN32.
